0 sends without waiting.
1. A member clicks Open ticket on the support panel published in the configured channel.
1. A member posts a message in a channel the bot can read.
1. A member submits an idea with /suggest; Helper posts it in the selected suggestions channel.
1. A moderator uses /event-create with a name, start date and location. Helper creates a native Discord scheduled event.
1. A moderator uses /giveaway-start with a prize, duration and number of winners.
1. A new member joins the server while Welcome is enabled.
1. Enable Achievements. Members earn medals through messages, voice, reactions, threads, boosts and XP.
1. Enable Economy and choose the currency and rewards.
1. Enable Invite tracking. Helper needs Manage Server to read invites.
1. Enable Temporary channels. Creating a category in the dashboard also sets up Creator Channel; staff can still use /temp-channel.
1. Use /poll with a question, at least two options and an optional duration. Helper uses the configured channel or the channel where you run the command.
1. With Birthdays enabled, a member uses /birthday-set with a day and month. No birth year is requested.
1. With Levels & XP enabled, eligible messages earn XP within your configured range. The cooldown and excluded channels are respected.
1. With the leaderboard enabled, use /leaderboard to see eligible members ranked from highest XP to lowest, up to the limit set in the dashboard.
2. A member joins using an existing invite. Helper compares its usage count.
2. Eligible members click Join on the giveaway message. Any configured required role is checked.
2. Helper checks the date in the configured time zone and posts your birthday message in the configured channel, mentioning the member.
2. Helper creates a private channel for the member, Helper and the configured support role. Administrators retain their Discord access.
2. Helper posts your greeting in the configured channel. Guide buttons open their chosen channels directly; buttons without a destination are hidden.
2. Join Creator Channel. Helper creates a room with your display name and moves you automatically.
2. Medals change color as members progress. The XP example uses existing XP; achievements do not award extra XP.
2. Members use /event-register with the event ID. Helper records registrations and respects any configured capacity.
2. Members vote using Support / Against (or Support only, depending on your settings).
2. Members vote using the option buttons. Voting again changes their choice.
2. Other members add the configured highlight reaction.
2. Reaching the next level triggers a level-up announcement. Role rewards are optional and need the right permissions and role hierarchy.
2. The dashboard controls whether the command response is public or private. This example uses a public response.
2. Use /daily once every 24 hours and /work after its configured cooldown.
3. A moderator uses /suggestion to approve, reject or mark the idea as considered. The public status is updated.
3. A support team member uses Claim to take the request, then Close when resolved. Closing behaviour follows your settings.
3. An optional automatic role needs the right permissions and role hierarchy. A welcome DM is optional and depends on the member’s privacy settings.
3. At the required count, Helper creates or updates its mirror in the selected Starboard channel.
3. Check your balance with /balance and the top 10 with /economy-top.
3. Members can use /birthday-remove to delete their saved birthday. The channel, message and time zone are set in the dashboard.
3. Reminders are optional: when enabled with an announcement channel, Helper posts there before the start. Registered members can use /event-checkin to record attendance.
3. Staff use /invites to see uses and optional inviter names. Joins are attributed only when the change is unambiguous.
3. The room stays while anyone is inside. It is deleted when the last member leaves; Creator Channel stays.
3. Use /achievements for your card and personal progress, or open the server collection on the site.
3. Use /leaderboard-privacy opt_out: true to hide your entry, or false to show it again. Hiding an entry does not delete XP.
3. Use /rank to view your XP card, level and server position. Voice XP is optional and only applies when enabled.
3. When the duration ends (or staff use /giveaway-end), Helper draws from the eligible entrants and publishes the result.
3. When the duration ends, Helper closes the poll, removes the voting buttons and shows the vote totals.
